propositions: 344 closed bugs lack aggregated trend analysis; ad-hoc scripts are required to compute close_class distribution, detection channel, age, caused_by fan-in, and time-to-close
close_class dimension must surface pre-convention era (MISSING cohort) as an explicit labeled bucket alongside vocabulary classes to prevent silent mixing of eras
detected_by field is sparse; the lens must degrade that dimension to unavailable without affecting other dimensions

FLOW dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close TRANSITION within ctx since/until range; STOCK dimensions (open-bug age percentiles, detected_by distribution, caused_by fan-in) are point-in-time measures over the current store and ignore the range
lens must be registered via standard registry _spec() pattern and imported in metrics __init__.py so REGISTRY discovers it
